messages:
Maya: quick health check for Nimbus Health — noticed error rate jump this morning, mainly 5xx and client timeouts. Can someone pull top failing endpoints and any recent config changes? @Alex :eyes:

Jonas: grabbing logs now. initial glance shows a spike around 08:12 UTC, correlated with a batch of long-context requests.

Priya: thanks. their spend and token volume are up ~18% w/w, might be hitting some rate policies. I'll share usage graph in a sec. :bar_chart:

Alex (eng-oncall): I see repeated 502s from the inference pool (gp2-dedicated-3). Also some 524 timeouts from the proxy layer. Suspect KV-cache pressure + large prompt sizes.

infra-alert-bot: Incident alert: 1765378429 - increased 5xx rate (threshold breached) for account:NimbusHealth, region:us-west-2.

Jonas: top failing endpoints (most hits first):
```
POST /v1/generate (5xx count: 428)
POST /v1/chat/stream (timeout: 312)
POST /v1/embeddings (5xx: 89)
POST /v1/re-rank (timeouts: 45)
GET  /v1/models (errors: 12)
```

Maya: nice, that matches the customer report. Any evidence of throttling/rate-limits?

Alex (eng-oncall): we saw a small number of 429s vs app-layer rules but not the majority. The primary failure mode is backend OOMs leading to 502s, then proxy-level 524s for long-running requests.

Priya: sharing quick usage snapshot: total tokens +18%, avg seq len +32%, p95 latency up from 420ms -> 1.1s. Could be their shift to longer contexts.

Maya: Ok, recommended immediate actions?

Alex (eng-oncall): short term: enable automatic fallback to quantized model variant for this account and cap max_input_tokens to 6k for 30m window. Also increase KV cache size for their pool. Long term: suggest canarying a lower-precision model and adjust batch sizing.

Jonas: I will propose the temporary config changes to the customer (explain tradeoffs). Also ask them to stagger large offline job submissions.

Priya: I'll update the account health dashboard and flag renewal risk as "monitoring" if errors don't drop within 24h.

Maya: perfect. I'll notify customer ops and schedule a 1:1 tomorrow to walk them through mitigations. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Alex (eng-oncall): after applying cache bump + fallback the 5xx rate dropped ~60% in staging. Will roll to prod in 10m and watch.

infra-alert-bot: Incident resolved: 1765378528 - 5xx rate reduced below threshold for account:NimbusHealth

Jonas: follow-up action items: [Priya] update dashboard + health note, [Alex] document incident root cause (OOM + long contexts), [Maya] customer comms.

Maya: assigning and closing thread unless more pops up.
